question: Where did Dr. Etienne Wamba complete his PhD?
answer: He completed his PhD in Mechanics and Material at the University of Yaoundé 1, Cameroon and was part of the cohort of founding tutors of the African Institute for Mathematical Sciences, Cameroon (AIMS-Cameroon).
